'''Kepkiriwát''' (Quêpi-quiri-uáte<ref name=":0">{{Cite book |last=Rondon|first=Cándido M. S.|url=https://etnolinguistica.wdfiles.com/local--files/biblio%3Arondon-1948-glossario/Rondon%26Faria_1948_GlossarioGeralTribos.pdf|title=Glossário geral das tribos silvícolas de Mato Grosso e outras da Amazônia e do Norte do Brasil: Tomo I|last2=de Faria|first2=João Barbosa|date=1948|publisher=Comissão Rondon|series=Publicação 76 do Conselho nacional de proteção dos Indios, Anexo|volume=5|location=Rio de Janeiro|pages=119–162|language=pt}}</ref>) is an extinct [[Tupian languages|Tupian language]] of the state of [[Rondônia]], in the Amazon region of [[Brazil]].

== Vocabulary ==
Loukotka (1949) compiles two wordlists of Kepkiriwát, one from an anonymous wordlist, marked '''A''', and a manuscript sent in 1924 to the archives of Manaus by Joaquim Gondim, an employee of the [[Indian Protection Service]] (SPI), marked '''G'''.
